question: CHMZ is related to WRMZ in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, NPWY is related to LJCA. Which of the given options is DGNO related to following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef1a08d1ac261dc312fe06bf091df2a759e46479c435e13d4eef66d50fd21097.png] 

The logic followed here is:

CHMZ is related to WRMZ,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31a4cfa2b3de6f4906d3f6676ed03022ac14c6e41edb5fe7468721d50f35550a.png] 

NPWY is related to LJCA,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e730e8fc87bd067aae6777e27f1045c3590bf2f900d2dbb1f8ac07f1f57e0fb2.png] 

Similarly, for DGNO 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b82832731847ee043cef8f51c8aa9d894cb597959c2bba81ae09ef1a73895e0.png] 

So, DGNO will be related to VSLK.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
